overview.description: Experimental design and statistics separate a real effect from noise. Design of Experiments (DoE) explores many factors efficiently instead of one-factor-at-a-time; proper replication and controls prevent the p-hacking that fails to reproduce.
objectives: design a multi-factor experiment (DoE) instead of OFAT
choose controls and sample size for adequate power
avoid p-hacking / HARKing and pre-specify the analysis

steps.description: Experimental design and statistics separate a real effect from noise. Design of Experiments (DoE) explores many factors efficiently instead of one-factor-at-a-time; proper replication and controls prevent the p-hacking that fails to reproduce.
steps.intro: Rigor is a skill, not a virtue: DoE finds interactions OFAT misses, and honest replication + pre-registration is what makes a result survive someone else repeating it.

instructions.title: State the hypothesis & plan
instructions.description: Pre-specify the question, factors, response, and analysis before collecting data.

instructions.title: Design efficiently
instructions.description: Use a factorial/response-surface DoE to vary factors together and detect interactions, instead of one factor at a time.

instructions.title: Replicate correctly
instructions.description: Include biological replicates (independent samples) - not just technical replicates - and enough for power.

instructions.title: Analyse as planned
instructions.description: Run the pre-specified analysis; report effect sizes and uncertainty, and resist fishing for significance.

submission.description: Take a naive one-factor-at-a-time plan and redesign it as a DoE with proper replication and controls, explaining what the redesign lets you detect that OFAT cannot.
